notes.title: Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.6 Patch Notes Halloween Special
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Halloween is almost here, and we’ve prepared something special for you. This update will be live for two weeks, so don’t miss out! It’s packed with Halloween spirit and 4 new exclusive scenes. 

In this Halloween special, you can look forward to: 

[list]
[*] New Room: Basement 
[*] 3 Halloween Quests: Complete these spooky challenges—beware of the jump scares! (We’re not here to traumatize anyone…but hey, it’s Halloween!) 
[*] 1 Seasonal Achievement: for completing all Halloween quests 
[*] 30 Exclusive Halloween Wallpapers: Available after completing the "Find Pumpkins" quest 
[*] 25 Halloween-Only Animations: Including 5 main scenes and, well, you know what... 
[*] Revamped Grabbing Function: Now merged with Interact. Press F (or a custom key) to interact, and hold to grab (if grabbable)
[*] Tutorial Screen Update: One new element added 
[/list]

1 New Major Feature: 

[list]
[*] Introducing the Commands Menu: Though still in a basic form, the Commands Menu will eventually play a key role in Story Mode, making future updates easier to manage. 
[/list]

Currently, you can activate it with TAB (or customize to your liking) and close it the same way, by clicking outside the menu (don't click on buttons) and pressing TAB, or by clicking the "X". 

Here’s what it currently offers: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/09fca31057aa81a5c0d661ec6b87a295ffb47941.jpg[/img]

[olist]
[*] Teleport – click to teleport within the house, it will also work with teleporting to other locations outside the house. 
[*] Day/Night Toggle – instantly switch from day to night, or vice versa. In the story it will work from morning to night 
[*] Hints – access a hint system to help with quests or you can see some typical ULT hints, especially useful for Halloween. 
[*] Close – close the Commands Menu.
[/olist]

Tell us what you think and what else should we add in the CommandsMenu. 

October’s been full of exciting progress and releases. For the next two weeks, we’ll pause updates so you can fully enjoy the Halloween special. Your feedback is always appreciated and valuable in our game development. We care for you all, and thank you for your support. Team will continue with the locations and Sophie. 

Until next time,
your ULT team.

For in game screenshots visit our [url=https://www.incetongames.com/unreal-lust-theory-news/unreal-lust-theory-v036]WEBPAGE[/url]

notes.title: Game price changes, future updates and Lovense's new toy!
notes.notes:
Hey ULT community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/95eab483087dc3e3c7366b263324d273c42eb5a4.png[/img]
It's hard to believe that we released Unreal Lust Theory almost six months ago! During that time, we've released over 10 updates, received tons of feedback, and so much love and support from our amazing players. From the start, the game was priced at [b]$5.99[/b], and we made sure not to raise the price with each update... until now.

To everyone who bought the game early or supported us on other sites by selecting the "I'm here because of Unreal Lust Theory" option, we want to say thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Your support means everything to us, and we're committed to delivering the best experience possible. We know there's still a LOT of work ahead, and we appreciate both the good and bad reviews as they help us improve.

As of now, the game’s price will be [b]$7.99[/b] and we plan to increase it further after adding more valuable content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/971f8948c33905e86426020b018b786a328ab17c.png[/img]

Thanks to our partnership with Lovense, we had the opportunity to test their newest toy, [b]Solace Pro[/b], in [b]Unreal Lust Theory[/b]!

We’ve given it a try, and it’s easily one of the best products for men—hands-free, great feel, and perfect for multitasking. Whether you’re gaming, relaxing, or… whatever you prefer, it’s entirely up to you!

The toy is available now! As a special thank you, Lovense is offering a [b]$10 off coupon[/b] till the 17th of September for [b]Solace Pro[/b], along with exclusive discounts on other toys when you use our link: https://www.lovense.com/a/IncetonGames

A huge thanks to Lovense for making this possible, and to our community for always being incredible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/bbd89ad231a8fa4352d8076394d6adf13165d89d.png[/img]

After testing the toy, we made some adjustments to optimize its capabilities. In the upcoming Main Menu update, we’ll ensure to release the new Lovense update, addressing those changes. We’re also working on fixing the bug related to user connection issues. If you're experiencing this problem, feel free to reach out to Seenko at any time.

About the new Main Menu: I know many of you are more interested in seeing new animations and characters. We apologize for the wait, but some things had to be prioritized first, especially fixing bugs caused by the plugin we used for the old menu. Since we didn’t have our own system, we couldn’t customize it the way we wanted. Now, we’re working to ensure everything functions exactly how we want.

On a positive note, we’ve found a new animator from Croatia who might be joining us in the office. Hopefully, we'll get him and try to give you as many animations as possible while you wait for the new locations.

Sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/0a77b96942b54a535ab72448e07b0f9a755f02c4.jpg[/img]

Thank you for reading and your support.

Hello everyone,

notes.title: Developer Update: Unreal Lust Theory Progress and Upcoming Features
notes.notes:
Hello, ULT community!

I think it's time our dear Steam supporters get an update on what's been going on. We’ve had some crazy weeks, so here it is:

First of all, thank you for the 100 positive reviews! They mean a lot to us, and we appreciate every single one of you, good and bad. We hope that one day, some of the negative reviews will become positive! We'll do our best!

[h2]Recent Progress:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Two words: jiggle physics! It looks better than we hoped for!

[*] We've finished all cum animations, totaling 142 new animations (cum inside, outside, and idle). This is one of the reasons for the delay in the update. Creating that many animations for existing sex animations isn’t easy or quick.

[*] We've added new cum sounds, and our sound guy gave us new walking sounds because you reported the existing ones were bad. We want to improve that!

[*] Drawing Method: We've completed our own method for drawing cum. It's still a learning process, but it's getting there. Here is a sneak peek of what I've learned, but remember, it’s not a finished product—I’ll get better in the coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/283c9969a2e7ab7664eb45aedebcc82aab5eb79a.jpg[/img]
[*] We've created some new clothes and are currently making a system inside Unreal that will change clothes in sex scenes, along with a system for displaying cum.

[*] Sophie, our perfect character, is now in the game! I didn't want to spoil anything, but I'm too excited. She will probably be released with the next update, but I'll leave the rest as a surprise!
[/olist]
[b]You can expect this update to go live at the end of this month or early July.[/b]

[h2]Future Plans:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] We are finishing up Ellie. The plan is to start with her dialogue face animations, level intro/tutorial scene, and give you some animations to test her out. For now, we only have sound in the dialogues, and we want to learn and create dialogue animations. Ellie will be our learning base since she's the first character you see in Story mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/5afb08b1057c38c9890588da18865670e831531b.jpg[/img]
[*] We'll also work on better walking and idle animations. We are aware of the issues.

[*] We plan to continue working on other locations, which we paused due to funding. Now we need to prepare a few more things and then take a few months to finish what we started. The store is 80-90% done, the college is 50%, the college interior is 20%, the mall is 40%, the mall interior is 0%, and the neighborhood is 60%, so there is still a lot of work to do.

[*] We want to upgrade our project to version 5.4.2. We believe this will allow us to provide a better game, and we hope nothing breaks in the process. We will take a few weeks to adjust after this update, or the next one.
[/olist]

[h2]Big Improvement:[/h2]

As I promised, every penny we made went back into creating this game. We hired a Croatian developer to make us a new main menu. I always dreamed of having a custom main menu, and this talented individual offered to help us because he loves what we do. If you wonder why we hired Croatian guy, our team of five is all from Croatia! And if you wonder why hire some to do it, it's because we lack the knowledge and time to create one ourselves. He is skilled and well-known for his work. I’m in contact with him daily to ensure he’s on the right path. This new menu will also fix bugs related to video settings and saving options, taking our game to the next level again!

I hope this gives you plenty of information for now. I have even more to share, but I don’t want to get ahead of myself. One step at a time, so be prepared for more updates in the future. Thank you again for supporting us and allowing us to continue with this game. Our love and this game belong to you! We appreciate all of you.

notes.title: Character Update: Sophie Completed and New Enhancements Ahead!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to give you a quick update about the characters. Today, we finished Sophie, the last character we needed from the original game, Lust Theory Season 1. If you're wondering why we haven't published Ellie, Nicole, or Zoe yet, this post is for you.

We completed their models a long time ago but continually needed to fix various issues during animation, which took up a lot of our time. So, we decided to take a few steps back to identify the problems. Eventually, we developed a new approach and agreed to make the last character we needed (for now, of course) the best version of them all.

With over a year of experience in creating LT characters, we've learned new techniques and improved our process. We took some extra time and finally created one character that we believe is perfect overall, with better-looking body shapes and hair. Some harsh edges remain, but the buttocks look better than ever.

Now that we have one character that meets our standards, we will start polishing our existing ones. First, we will work on MC and Megan because they were our first created characters, and it's clear that MC is far from perfect and Megan needs some adjustments. This way, we will have all characters perfected and ready for the story mode.

You already know that we are preparing and doing our best to start the story, and we don't want to give you something that doesn't look right. Polishing the characters and providing you with the best visuals is important, and we want to give you the best game possible. The biggest changes will be on MC and Megan, but after them, the other characters will be done more quickly. They will appear in the Updates according to the poll votes on our Discord: 1. Nicole, 2. Ellie, 3. Zoe, 4. Sophie, but maybe we should publish Sophie first, after all, she is finished and the reason we are doing all of this :D Let me know in the comments below. 

With this new character approach, motion capturing and face capture are now possible, meaning we can provide you with even better animations and, finally, real-feel dialogues.

We are so grateful for your support and this community. In return, we are doing our best to give you our maximum effort and a finished product, not something half done. Giving you the best characters is important, and with this approach, we believe this game will be even better than we thought.

Thank you for being here. That’s it for this character info. I'm here for your questions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/3c220ab9c6a3ad2be7c3d6fc4fe758d59c7a7c35.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 🎮 Unreal Lust Theory v0.3.1 Patch Notes 🎮
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44586371/ff1f971d7d3c8666e1532083ff2c3bb2e7f2ec28.jpg[/img]

Greetings everyone!

We've wrote down all of your much-needed feedback and ideas, and we've begun implementing them after a short, but necessary break. Thank you so much for your invaluable support; we truly appreciate each and every one of you! While there are still a few more issues to address, such as the save option, but for it we need to re-do whole main menu (which will take some time), we're excited to share this update with you:

NOTE: Price of the game with this update won't change.

🛠️ Improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed clipping issues in animations.
[*] Added keybindings; now all controls except for the default skip dialogue (left ctrl) can be customized to your preference.
[*] Added 96+ images for keybindings, allowing your controls widget to display any key you've inserted or changed (images are for US layout).
[*] Updated the appearance of default sex and normal controls.
[*] In Drone mode, right-click now displays the exit option for sex scenes, replacing the previous ESC key function.
[*] ESC key now functions to exit windows; no need to click exit with the mouse.
[*] ENTER key works now when entering names, you don't need to click accept anymore
[*] SANDBOX mode can now be played only using the keyboard.
[*] Implemented community-suggested feature: the punching bag now reacts to punches, with added physics.
[/list]

🐞 Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Resolved mouse sensitivity and mouse invert issues.
[*] Fixed inability to exit Quest Journal with ESC key.
[*] Addressed instances of getting stuck in Elizabeth's room.
[*] Fixed mouse locking in-app, ensuring the mouse remains within the monitor screen.
[*] Corrected issue where mirrors on medium graphics did not display walls.
[*] Adjusted UI scaling.
[*] Improved functionality of leaving dialogues without requiring additional input (note: first dialogue with Jessica cannot be skipped, as she needs to provide a quest).
[*] ESC key in sex scene now properly exits to the pause menu.
[*] Fixed inability to open or close the garage door.
[/list]

🗺️ Localization:

Fixed words and sentences for reported languages only. Updated languages: French, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Indonesian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazilian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian.

🌟 Upcoming Features:

[list]
[*] Cum inside and outside animations and fluids are currently in progress; expect to test them out in approximately one more week.
[*] sexy clothes for girls are in the making, more info coming soon
[*] new Main Menu and controller support, more info coming soon
[*] Updates on other characters will be revealed in the next update
[/list]

📣 Community Feedback:
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to our amazing community for their invaluable feedback and support. We couldn't do any of this without you! Your passion and enthusiasm continue to inspire us every day, and we're committed to delivering the best possible gaming experience for all of you. Together, let's make Unreal Lust Theory the ultimate gaming experience!

As always, if you encounter any issues or have suggestions for future updates, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our official Discord server or our Community hub. 

Happy gaming!
ULT team!
